lots.what_it_is: Amphora (Turn-Teplitz, Bohemia) Egyptian-revival or Art Deco squat jug, mottled green and yellow matte glaze, enamelled geometric band in lavender, pink, orange and yellow with raised dots, copper-speckled handle and rim. Blue oval stamp read in the photo: 'Made in Czecho-Slovakia AMPHORA', so made 1919 to about 1939. Impressed numbers on the base (88 and a four-digit shape number, about 15?9) plus incised XVIII.

lots.what_it_is: Box of roughly 25 to 35 narrow glass toy magic lantern slides in red, green and pink paper-bound frames, with chromolithographed (printed transfer) round vignettes: one green slide with 5 castle and house scenes, one pink slide with 5 comic figures (clowns, animals in costume) with paper and glass edge loss, one red slide numbered 1 to 4 with village, winter, sea and tropical scenes. Looks like late 19th or early 20th century German children's toy lantern slides, not photographic or scientific slides. The sports, maritime and railway content in the title is not visible in the single photo.
